text: {"assertions":["On 2026-01-20, a latency spike issue was investigated in ml/serving/batcher.py on the ml pipeline side.","The latency spike in the batcher only occurred for tenants with more than 10,000 distinct keys.","The root cause of the latency spike was floating point rounding in the money path.","The signal for the latency spike was a tail far above the median in the serving histogram.","The fix involved moving arithmetic to integer minor units and was implemented in PR #2051 on branch fix/latency-spike-1.","The latency spike was reproducible by sending the mixed-size request trace.","After the fix was applied, a job that previously took 2 hours completed in 31 minutes.","This work was a continuation of earlier latency spike investigation work in the same area of the codebase."]}
